voltage_domain_warnings.description: ThickGateOx (44/0) marks sg13g2's thick-gate-oxide ('-HV') MOS voltage domain (see general_derivations.lvs's ngate_hv_base/pgate_hv_base). EXTRACTION_DECK models it for MOS device recognition/model binding (issue #1231: sg13_hv_nmos/sg13_hv_pmos under --pdk); this curated deck's DRC rules still apply the general-case ('-LV') thresholds to geometry regardless of ThickGateOx's presence (e.g. the Gat.a1/Gat.a2 channel-length-specific GatPoly widths, not transcribed in this deck yet).

unchecked_rules.description: NW.b1 (min. PWell width between NWell regions of different nets, 1.80 um) is net-aware and this engine has no net-aware spacing check; wells on different nets closer than 1.80 um are not flagged. Only the geometric nwell.space.1 (0.62 um) ran.

runset_correspondence.note: PDK rule NW.c first removes P+ Activ that interacts with a text-recognised SVaricap (`lNw_c = PActLV.ext_not(PActLV.ext_interacting(SVaricap))`, SVaricap = NWell under an "SVaricap" text label on a GatPoly stack); this deck checks every P+ Activ unconditionally, so findings whose source_cell is a PDK SVaricap device are expected to be absent from the runset (deck over-report, not a real enclosure violation).
